premise: Lola calls into the rock pool; Octopus touches her finger with the tip of an arm and tickles her: he's tasting her, because octopuses taste with their suckers.
inspiration: The first-meeting folk motif (the stranger's strange greeting) turned true and ticklish: the odd hello is how an octopus says it.
lesson: Different ways of saying hello are still hello.
learning: An octopus tastes things with the suckers on its arms.

en-US.title: Octopus Says Hello
en-US.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola knelt at the edge of the rock pool. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [whispers] "Hello? Is anybody home?" {octopus:enter} Out came Octopus, {octopus:face surprised} orange and curly. {octopus:live} He waved all eight arms. Then he reached out the tip of one arm… and touched Lola's finger. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [giggles] "That tickles!" [playfully] I'm tasting you, said Octopus. {octopus:face happy} I taste things with the little suckers on my arms. {girl:says} [curious] "What do I taste like?" Octopus thought. {octopus:pulse} Hmm… like salt, and sand, and sandwiches. [laughs] {girl:face happy} {girl:hop} {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish, watching nearby, {starfish:live} waved one arm hello. {girl:says} [excited] "Can I taste you back?" {octopus:wobble} Octopus wiggled. I'll just shake your hand, he said. {octopus:hearts} So he did. Eight times.

es-ES.title: Pulpo dice hola
es-ES.text: {girl:enter} {girl:go to pool} Lola se arrodilló al borde de la charca. {girl:face happy} {girl:says} [whispers] «¿Hola? ¿Hay alguien en casa?» {octopus:enter} Salió Pulpo, {octopus:face surprised} naranja y rizado. {octopus:live} Saludó con sus ocho brazos. Luego estiró la punta de un brazo… y tocó el dedo de Lola. {girl:face surprised} {girl:says} [giggles] «¡Me hace cosquillas!» [playfully] Te estoy probando, dijo Pulpo. {octopus:face happy} Yo saboreo las cosas con las ventosas de mis brazos. {girl:says} [curious] «¿Y a qué sé?» Pulpo se lo pensó. {octopus:pulse} Mmm… a sal, a arena y a bocadillo. [laughs] {girl:face happy} {girl:hop} {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella, que miraba al lado, {starfish:live} saludó con un brazo. {girl:says} [excited] «¿Puedo probarte yo a ti?» {octopus:wobble} Pulpo se meneó. Mejor te doy la mano, dijo. {octopus:hearts} Y eso hizo. Ocho veces.
